decision.summary: The bedroom window job has a provider assigned who has ignored seven reminders, so no further reminder was sent. The landlord's only reply named a different flat, so it is not approval; he has been asked which property he meant and whether we may use our contractor. The tenant was updated and a P3 swap recommendation escalated.

answers.answer: Provider assigned 1 Mar but silent despite 7 reminders; no visit booked; landlord approval never validly given (reply named Flat 18, 88 Alder Lane); toilet issue withdrawn by tenant.

answers.answer: Landlord approval/clarification request by email (A1), tenant update by email (A2), P3 escalation recommending provider swap (A3), follow-up 13 Mar (A4).

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Yes, P3: swapping the unresponsive provider, as no alternative contractor is named and landlord authority is unclear.
